text_block_list.text: Taking a break from training, I came to the park with King Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...The wind is quite strong today, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, dust kicks up on windy days, right?
I... hate that...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sand gets all over your clothes and hair,
and on top of that, you sneeze—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I literally just said not to!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
This is why I hate dirt tracks...
